title: 一致性作为分布：委托契约、错误预算与基于用途的AI监管中的评估权分配
summary: 论文提出将AI部署的"一致性"定义为在声明上下文分布下的失败率，而非模型属性，并研究部署者、审计者与执法方之间的策略博弈。给出五个机制与命题：适当评分惩罚约束部署者超额失败、提交-揭示审计无偏、α投资维持长期认证覆盖、子群保证的审计规模随子群质量按1/m缩放、仅计失败的指标会错误偏好撤回。
summary_en: The paper reframes AI deployment conformance as a failure rate under a declared context distribution rather than a model property, and studies strategic play among deployer, auditor, and enforcement point. It offers five mechanisms with propositions: a proper-scoring penalty bounds deployer excess failure, commit-reveal auditing is unbiased by construction, alpha-investing sustains long-lived certification, per-subgroup guarantees cost audit size scaling as 1/m, and failure-only incident metrics wrongly prefer withdrawal.
